_source.prompt: Flat cut-out pattern sheet, square, 2048x2048, on a solid flat bright magenta background (#ff00ff) filling every pierced opening cleanly with crisp hard edges and zero anti-aliased pink halo; no magenta, pink or purple anywhere on the brick or tile. Flat, even, shadowless lighting. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: a pierced architectural claustra breeze-screen wall built of canted warm sandy-buff bricks (#d4b88e) and terracotta-ochre bricks (#bf684c) mortared at 45-degree angles in an interlocking diamond-and-cross honeycomb lattice, with small square alkaline-teal glazed ceramic boss tiles (#1c8a84) set at every lattice intersection and pale lime mortar (#dfd5c2) at the joints, framing clean open geometric ventilation apertures (#ff00ff). No perspective, no text, no border, no watermark.
